summary: Compile policy.json into settings.json, hooks and lock.json; validate and diff
usage: bot-secure policy <compile [--os darwin|linux|win32] [--dry-run] [--force] | diff | validate | show>
valid: policy.json is valid ({apps} app(s), profile {profile}, mode {mode}).
humanEdited: {path} was edited by hand: wrote {path}.new (review and merge, or use --force).
guardShim: dist/guard.mjs not found: wrote a development guard that imports the source (run npm run build for the real one).
win32Sensitive: Profile sensitive on native Windows: no sandbox available; use WSL2 for real containment.
diffNone: No changes: artifacts match the policy.
